title: Essex EEG Movie Memory dataset
description: This dataset comprises raw EEG recordings from 27 participants who viewed 10-second movie clips previously seen by them, reporting recognition and memory of each clip. For recognized clips, participants indicated specific moments prompting recall via mouse-click annotations during a second viewing. The dataset supports research into neural correlates of video memorability and recognition memory.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 electrodes arranged according to the international 10-20 system, sampled at 2048 Hz. Participants watched 10-second movie clips and reported recognition and memory status; recognized or remembered clips were replayed with mouse-click annotations marking recognition-triggering moments.
